description_en: Queries information about one or more ApsaraDB for Redis (Tair-compatible) instances
description_zh: 查询一个或多个云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的信息
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-ids r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --instance-status Normal --charge-type PostPaid --network-type CLASSIC --engine-version 4.0 --instance-class redis.master.small.default --vpc-id vpc-bp1nme44gek34slfc0000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp1e7clcw529l773d0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --instance-type Redis --search-key apitest --architecture-type standard --expired false --zone-id cn-hongkong-b --resource-group-id rg-acfmyiu4ekp0000 --global-instance true --edition-type Enterprise --private-ip 172.16.49.000 --tag Value=开发 Key=存储类型 --node-type MASTER_SLAVE --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstances

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance.

When calling this API, if the Tag parameter is specified, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
实例所属的地域ID。

调用本接口时，如果传入了Tag参数，则本参数必须传入
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the instances to query.
To specify multiple instance IDs, separate them with commas (,). A maximum of 30 instance IDs can be specified in a single request
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的实例ID。
如需传入多个实例ID时，使用英文逗号（,）分隔实例ID，最多一个请求传入 30 个实例ID
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
The status of the instance. Valid values:
Normal: normal.
Creating: being created.
Changing: being changed.
Inactive: disabled.
Flushing: being flushed.
Released: released.
Transforming: being transformed.
Migrating: being migrated.
BackupRecovering: being restored from a backup.
MinorVersionUpgrading: minor version being upgraded.
NetworkModifying: network type being changed.
SSLModifying: SSL being changed.
MajorVersionUpgrading: major version being upgraded. The instance can be accessed normally.

For more information about instance statuses, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200740.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态，取值：
Normal：正常。
Creating：创建中。
Changing：修改中。
Inactive：被禁用。
Flushing：清除中。
Released：已释放。
Transforming：转换中。
Migrating：迁移中。
BackupRecovering：备份恢复中。
MinorVersionUpgrading：小版本升级中。
NetworkModifying：网络变更中。
SSLModifying：SSL变更中。
MajorVersionUpgrading：大版本升级中，可正常访问。

更多实例状态及详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200740.html
parameters.name: instance_status

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值：
PrePaid：预付费，即包年包月。
PostPaid：后付费，即按量付费
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:
CLASSIC: classic network.
VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC)
parameters.help_zh:
网络类型，取值：
CLASSIC：经典网络。
VPC：专有网络
parameters.name: network_type

parameters.help_en: The Redis-compatible engine version of the instance. Valid values: 2.8, 4.0, 5.0, 6.0, and 7.0
parameters.help_zh: 实例兼容Redis的版本，取值：2.8、4.0、5.0、6.0或7.0
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en: The instance type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107984.html
parameters.help_zh: 实例规格，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107984.html。
parameters.name: instance_class

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the instance list. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 实例列表的页码，起始值为1，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页最多可显示的行数，最大值为50，默认值为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The category of the instance. Valid values:
Tair: Tair (Enhanced Edition)
Redis: ApsaraDB for Redis Community Edition
Memcache
parameters.help_zh:
实例类型，取值：
Tair：Tair（企业版）
Redis：Redis开源版
Memcache
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The keyword used for fuzzy search by instance name or instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 支持模糊搜索实例名称或实例ID
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en:
The architecture type. Valid values:
cluster: cluster.
standard: standard.
rwsplit: read/write splitting
parameters.help_zh:
架构类型，取值：
cluster：集群版。
standard：标准版。
rwsplit：读写分离版
parameters.name: architecture_type

parameters.help_en:
The expiration status of the instance. Valid values:

true: expired.
false: not expired
parameters.help_zh:
实例的过期状态，取值：

true：已过期。
false：未过期
parameters.name: expired

parameters.help_en: The zone ID
parameters.help_zh: 可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html API or use the console to obtain the list of resource group IDs. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html接口或通过控制台获取资源组ID列表。相关操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to filter child instances of distributed instances from the returned instance list. Valid values:
true: returns only child instance information.
false: does not return child instance information
parameters.help_zh:
返回的实例列表中，是否过滤分布式实例中的子实例，取值：
true：只返回子实例信息。
false：不返回子实例信息
parameters.name: global_instance

parameters.help_en:
The edition of the instance. Valid values:
Community: ApsaraDB for Redis Community Edition.
Enterprise: Tair Enhanced Edition
parameters.help_zh:
实例类型，取值：
Community：Redis开源版。
Enterprise：Tair企业版
parameters.name: edition_type

parameters.help_en: The private IP address of the VPC
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络IP地址
parameters.name: private_ip

fields.help_en:
The key of the tag. The tag key and value together form a key-value pair.
A maximum of 5 tag key-value pairs can be specified at a time
fields.help_zh:
标签的键，与Tag Value组成标签的键值对。
单次最多支持传入5组标签的键值对
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the tag. The tag value and key together form a key-value pair
fields.help_zh: 标签键的值，与Tag Key组成标签的键值对
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例的标签信息
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The node type. Valid values:
MASTER_SLAVE: high availability (dual-replica)
STAND_ALONE: single replica
double: dual-replica
single: single replica
For cloud-native instances, select MASTER_SLAVE or STAND_ALONE. For classic instances, select double or single
parameters.help_zh:
节点类型，取值：
MASTER_SLAVE：高可用（双副本）
STAND_ALONE：单副本
double：双副本
single：单副本
云原生版实例请选择MASTER_SLAVE或STAND_ALONE，经典版实例请选择double或single
parameters.name: node_type

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the instance list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 输入时设置的每页行数
